name: Materialise Template
description: The parameter values a Template sets are values the parameters allow. The check changes nothing; the unravel step writes the rows.

conditions.statement: Every parameter value set on the Template is allowed by the parameter before the Template moves from Draft to Validated.

requiredEvidence.title: Template Materialisation Check Record
requiredEvidence.description: The result of the materialisation check run when the Template is validated.
